notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the standard service-reporting interlock. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador boundary, standard MIM declarations, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, application FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies the public get/set service-reporting switch and the standard HLAreportServiceInvocation active/passive subscription constraints, including recovery after unsubscribe. Provider-private headers, registries, file sinks, names, and diagnostics are outside this contract.
